title: bench(sql-perf): measure R8, R9 and R10 on the M0 harness — share, roll-up and network legs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbGfxE9QQTsFJp457cGiCViY)_

Fixes #33701

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只改 SQL 性能基准(`packages/qa/dogfood/bench/sql-perf/`,私有包、不发布),给 M0 基准加了三条测量腿:记录共享授权播种(R9)、汇总字段(R10)、经网络延迟代理访问 PostgreSQL 与授权缓存开关(R8)。零产品代码。
- 为什么改:史诗 #33631 的排行榜里 R8/R9/R10 三项没量过;本卡把它们量出来,按"是否值得做"排序,交席位决定立哪张 M2 卡。
- 风险与回滚:只影响手工运行的基准脚本和它的测试应用;不进 dogfood 测试集,不进任何发布包。回滚即还原这 4 个文件。
- 先看:`bench.mjs`(新参数 `--shares`、`--db-latency-ms`、`--grants-cache-ttl-ms`、`--sql-log` 与延迟代理)、`app/objectstack.config.ts`(三组汇总字段对照对象)、`micro.mjs`(I9、I10 两组 SQL 对照)。
- 两分钟验证:`node packages/qa/dogfood/bench/sql-perf/bench.mjs --dialect sqlite --scale 10000 --iterations 3 --shares 50 --only scoped_account_list,rollup1_insert_p1`,预期成员可见账户 60(自有 10 + 共享 50),`rollup1_insert_p1` 为 213 条语句。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地;另有一处真实缺陷(共享授权超过 5000 条后被静默丢弃,成员按 id 读被共享的记录得到 404)已交席位立卡。

## What changes

Bench legs and fixture only (`packages/qa/dogfood/bench/sql-perf/**`); no product code.

- `bench.mjs`
  - `--shares N` (R9): seeds N `sys_record_share` read grants to the member, written as the sharing service stores a manual grant, spread over the accounts the member does not own. The run checks what the member sees (account total vs owned + shared) and reads the first and the last shared account by id.
  - `--db-latency-ms N` (R8, `pg` only): an in-process TCP proxy between the measuring server and PostgreSQL that holds each chunk N/2 ms each way. The run measures `select 1` directly and through the proxy and records the chunks it forwarded.
  - `--grants-cache-ttl-ms N` (R8): boots the measuring server with `OS_AUTHZ_GRANTS_CACHE_TTL_MS=N` and records the server's own `[authz-cache]` boot line as the proof of the posture.
  - `--sql-log`: every statement of one warm request per scenario, the member's included (knex `DEBUG=knex:query` on the server, the log lines gained during that request). The debug-timing header lists only the 20 slowest, and only to an admin.
  - New scenarios: `public_list_tiny` (admin, member: a public 1-row list, so all but 2 statements are identity work) and 15 roll-up writes (`rollupN_insert_pP`, `rollupN_update_pP`, `rollupN_insert_one`; N = 0, 1, 2 summary fields, P = 1 or 10 distinct parents, 50-row `createMany` / `updateMany`). A scenario body can be a function of the call number, so no two writes are identical.
  - Result files of a run with a leg are suffixed (`-shares900`, `-rtt10`, `-gc60000`, `-sqllog`) and never overwrite the baseline's.
- `app/objectstack.config.ts`: three fixed-size roll-up pairs `bench_roll0..2` (200 parents × 50 children, public, master-detail) identical but for 0 / 1 / 2 `summary` fields; the 0-field pair is the control. The existing scenarios' statement counts are unchanged by them (10, 14, 10, 12, 16, 9, 9, 11, 9, 9, 11, 10, 9, 18, 31, 10, 14, 14 and 155 for the cascade, as in the M0 baseline).
- `micro.mjs`: `--only m0,r9,r10` groups; I9 (share scope: today's grants read + `id in (…)` vs a `sys_record_share` subquery, page and total, account list and the controlled-by-parent chain) and I10 (roll-up recompute: 80 per-parent statements vs one grouped aggregate + one update per parent). Both compare the answer as well as the time.
- `README.md`: the four flags, the three legs and how each proves it exercises its path.

The readings, the ranking and the H2 defect are in the addendum on #33631 (a comment there, stamped with this PR's head sha). Headline, from this card's runs only:

- **R10** `updateMany` of 50 children recomputes per child row per summary field: 358 → 558 → 758 statements for 0 / 1 / 2 summaries (both dialects); `createMany` pays per distinct parent per field (209 → 249 → 289 over 10 parents). I10: 80 → 11 statements, PG 15.8 → 2.15 ms.
- **R9** the grants read runs twice per member list; at 5000 grants I9 PG 21.6 → 7.0 ms for the account scope, SQLite 18.3 → 12.1. **H2 reproduced**: past 5000 grants the rest are dropped (6000 grants: 6000 visible of 7000, `GET /data/bench_account/ac00009998` 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`), both dialects.
- **R8** identity is 8 statements per request; through the proxy a 1-row list goes 9.3 → 29.3 ms (2 ms RTT) → 75.7 ms (10 ms); the grants cache cuts identity to 2 statements and recovers 11–25 ms.

## Tests

No test file changes: the bench is not collected by vitest (`test/**` only), and it changes no tested behaviour, so there is nothing to ablate. Each leg proves it runs the path it names, by a control in the same harness:

- R9: shares 0 vs 900 vs 5000 — the member's account total moves 100 → 1000 (100k) and 1000 → 6000 (1M); the largest statement of the request carries 4 binds with no grants and 902 with 900 (`--sql-log`).
- R10: the 0-summary pair — 209 / 213 / 217 statements for a 50-row insert on one parent, 358 / 558 / 758 for the update; the captured statements show `select sum(quantity)` / `select count(*)` and `update bench_rollN` only on N ≥ 1.
- R8: `select 1` 0.1 ms direct, 2.4 / 10.6 ms through the proxy; the cache-on runs print `grants cache ENABLED (ttl=60000ms)` and drop the public list from 10 to 4 statements.

## Acceptance notes

- Not measured: hierarchy read scopes (the fixture has no hierarchy); grants through teams, roles or rules; R10 writes through the network proxy (the network cost there is statement count × the measured RTT, stated as arithmetic); MySQL and Turso (not on this box).
- PostgreSQL ran on a private cluster with `fsync=off` and `synchronous_commit=off` throughout, so write milliseconds are understated; statement counts are exact.
- Observed, not ranked: a 50-row batch write is mostly per-row work even with no summary field (`createMany` reads the master twice per row and writes one audit and one activity row per row; `updateMany` reads each child four times); a member read of a private object also reads `sys_queue` per scoped statement; the analytics member path ANDs the share-scoped chain twice.

## Verification

Bench readings: SQLite and a private PostgreSQL 16 cluster, engine tree `origin/main` @ `a557fa386`, bench commits `45aa1a521`, `1634e0714`, `697ba8f9f` (each result file is stamped with the commit it ran at); the full tables are in the addendum on #33631. Gates below are on the final head `ae8ecd623` (merge of `origin/main` @ `b76df9a69`, no incoming change under `packages/qa/dogfood/bench/`).

<details><summary>Derived gate families: 46 derived, 44 exit 0, 2 not measured locally</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `ae8ecd623`: 46 commands for the 4 changed paths (8 of them whole-tree). Each run with its exit code captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconciliation: `46 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 45 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.

- 44 exit 0, among them `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:published-files`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` (+ `--self-test`), `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (after fetching its pinned fixture commit into the shallow clone).
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (packages outside the CLI closure have no `dist/`): NOT MEASURED locally, CI's run is the reading.
- `pnpm check:dts-closure` exit 1: the local closure was built with `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`, so every package lacks its `.d.ts` (`missing packages/adapters/hono/dist/index.d.ts` …); not a reading of this diff, which touches no package build. CI's run is the reading.

</details>

<details><summary>Type check, lint</summary>

- The fixture alone through the dogfood `tsconfig.json` (`tsc --noEmit -p` a temporary config extending it, `include` = the fixture; `--listFiles` lists it): first red (`TS2322` on the untyped helper's widened literals), then exit 0 once the helper returns `ServiceObject[]` with `Field` summaries. The whole `@objectstack/dogfood` typecheck is declared to CI: locally it needs the `.d.ts` of its whole dependency closure, which the `OS_SKIP_DTS` build does not emit (it fails on `@objectstack/core` / `spec/automation` declarations, not on this diff).
- `eslint packages/qa/dogfood/bench/sql-perf/`: 3 files linted, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The repository-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run.

</details>
